issues.display_title: Issue #1788: Reroute gothru_mod_live DB connection to gothru_mod
issues.main_description_html:
Context: host 192.168.1.129:3313 (gothru_mod_live) went network-unreachable ("No route to host") starting 2026-08-19 ~01:52 UTC, causing 503s on /auth/login and 8 other endpoints. gothru_mod (.53:3306) has the same DB name/schema and same credentials, making a safe reroute possible.

Tasks:

  • In app/Class/DatabaseClass.php, point tableSessionLive() and tableConfigLive() at dbGothruMod() instead of dbModLive()
  • In app/Class/DatabaseClass.php, point dbModLive() itself at the gothru_mod connection (cascades to tableUserLive, tableAgencyLive, tableUserExtraDataLive, tableUserActivityLive, tableRssLive, tablePortfolioLive, tableAuthLive)
  • In app/Repositories/Payment/PaymentDatabaseRepository.php, change tableUsersLive() connection from gothru_mod_live to gothru_mod
  • Mark each change with a ponytail: comment noting it's temporary pending .129 status confirmation
  • Grep codebase to confirm no remaining active code path references the gothru_mod_live connection name
  • Commit and push to main

Files changed: app/Class/DatabaseClass.php, app/Repositories/Payment/PaymentDatabaseRepository.php

Result

Implemented and shipped in commit fa1f0b969 on main.

  • All 9 previously affected endpoints (4 login endpoints, register-verification, public overlay, getDataSubscribe, getDataSubsStipe) now read/write through gothru_mod (.53:3306) instead of gothru_mod_live (.129:3313).
  • Verified via grep: no remaining active code path references the gothru_mod_live connection.
  • Changes marked with ponytail: comments as temporary, pending confirmation of .129 status.
  • Not yet deployed to production — deploy + endpoint verification still pending.

issues.display_title: Issue #1786: Add Plunk email template for Stripe auto-cancel notification
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Create a Plunk template + EmailTemplateUID entry for the failed-payment auto-cancel email, for the new Stripe cron in #1785 to send instead of the legacy inline-HTML sendEmail() string.

Current state

No Plunk template exists for this. Legacy cron builds two raw HTML variants inline (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-cancel-users-account-cron-research.md for exact copy): a generic "subscription cancelled" notice, and a detail variant when overlays were active or space was over 10GB.

Target state

Plunk template(s) covering both variants (or one template with conditional blocks), plus a new EmailTemplateUID constant for #1785 to reference. Follows the same pattern as NOTIFY_NEW_INVOICE (#1777/#1778).

Scope

Plunk dashboard (template content/design), EmailTemplateUID class in this repo.

Out of scope

The H-3/H-1/H-0 reminder-sequence templates — only in scope if #1785 decides to extend reminders to the auto-cancel flow (currently open question, not yet decided).

Risk / test plan

Manual send test via Plunk preview / cron test_mode once #1785 wires the call.

Result
